extracted.intended_audience: marketers, PR professionals, content creators, and small business owners creating press-release infographics
extracted.subtask_description: Designing an informational infographic that highlights different types of press releases for business communication, using a customizable template and visual assets. Covers layout, visual styling, data visualization, interactivity, export, and branding considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlight the various types of press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the infographic to present and emphasize the different types of press releases you can make to improve your business communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template features a circular design layout to present each press release type, along with a creative collection of vector icons and professional fonts. Start by identifying which press release types are relevant and give each a clear, distinct visual treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose and apply color themes and font styles
rubrics_metrics.description: Change color themes and font styles to match your brand and improve readability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide on a color scheme and insert content. The template allows changing color themes and font styles with a few clicks; you can apply custom colors and input your own fonts and logo to maintain brand consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use visual assets (icons, images, illustrations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporate graphics and icons to make information easier to scan and more engaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access millions of free graphics from inside the editor, including vector graphics, stock images, and icons. Use appropriate icons for each press-release type and combine with imagery to add personality and aid comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visualize data with widgets, maps and charts
rubrics_metrics.description: Represent statistics or comparative information using charts, maps, and custom widgets rather than long text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visualize data with custom widgets, maps and charts to communicate key figures quickly and clearly. Prefer charts (bar, pie, etc.) and maps for geographic data to avoid overwhelming readers with raw numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add interactivity where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Include interactive elements—animations, hover effects, or links—to increase engagement in digital formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add interactivity like animation, hover effects and links. Use interactive features sparingly and purposefully (e.g., reveal extra detail on hover, link to full articles) to avoid distraction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select appropriate export formats and sharing methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose file formats and sharing options that match your distribution channel (web, email, print).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download in JPG, PNG, PDF and HTML5 format; embed into a blog post or webpage, or generate a shareable link for online use. For print use high-resolution JPEG/PDF; for interactive web use HTML5 or embedded links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set correct dimensions and layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the infographic's dimensions and layout suit the intended medium and audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All infographic templates are 800 pixels wide with varying lengths; these dimensions can be easily changed and the length adjusted with a slider. Decide what you want your infographic layout to look like and adjust width/length accordingly for social, web, or print.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customize content and branding
rubrics_metrics.description: Edit text, images and other elements to reflect your message and brand identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This template can be fully customized: edit content, change images, apply custom colors, input your own fonts and logo, and more. Ensure logos and brand colors are used consistently and that copy is tailored to your audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep design clean and simple
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid clutter and excessive detail so readers stay engaged and absorb the main points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Infographics are one of the best ways to grab your audience’s attention without overwhelming them with too many details. Use clean and simple designs to keep readers engaged with your content rather than glossing over it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan a clear workflow and layout before designing
rubrics_metrics.description: Outline the sequence and hierarchy of information and choose a layout that supports that flow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Go step-by-step to find the perfect workflow for you and your team: decide what you want your infographic layout to look like, choose a color scheme and insert your content. Map content hierarchy so the most important items are prominent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use drag-and-drop tools to simplify production
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage intuitive editor features so non-designers can produce polished infographics quickly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visme’s infographic maker is designed to help you create infographics in a fraction of the time; with its drag-and-drop solution you can create and customize layouts without needing years of design experience. Use templates as a starting point and iterate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add personalized touches with advanced assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhance uniqueness and brand fit by using advanced assets like animated charts or 3D characters when suitable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can also access thousands of design assets like animated charts or graphs, 3D characters, vector graphics, stock images, icons and so much more, to add personal touches to your design. Use these selectively so they support, not overshadow, the message.
